objective: Frozen computation: exact distributions of NN and NN2 from every bracketing of 5 to 8 distinctions to n = 12; labelled runs of NN, NN2, KF3 and SUB to n = 40; NNF from the line of 5 to 8 and the 2 x 2 pattern, and the class law, to n = 40.
status: Supported 2026-11-18 (referee pending; 5 of 8 held; P1, P3, P5 failed): the never-nest rule with knots only on co-knotted pairs (NN, B197) keeps two orders at every step and grows full two-way grids (median fill fraction 0.80 on steps 21-40, a full grid at some n in 30-40 in 93-100% of runs from every bracketing of 5 to 8; exact to n = 12); NN2 the same; NNF and CC as proved (300 of 300 runs); CC after one fill reaches a full grid only when that fill spans the line (31 of 200); KF3 leaves two orders in every run.
title: Never-nest growth from every bracketing
